scope: Column-warp GDN prefill on layers 27-47 (llama gated_delta_net layout): one warp per (v_head, column) with the 128 state rows sharded across lanes in registers, warp-shuffle reductions, no __syncthreads in the token loop; companion in-place rms-norm+gate tail kernel. Replaces the strict fused owner (27-34) and peer-GDN (35-47) on those layers within the production stack

kernel.name: qwen4_exp_gdn_prefill_columnwarps_f32_kernel
kernel.notes: in-place tail kernel (norm_weight indexed [0..127] shared across heads, matching the fused owner); ~4096 warps in flight vs 32 blocks

performance.protocol: counterbalanced 8-rep alternating vs current production (peer-GDN 35-47), one residency per length, median of four per mode
performance.note: largest single retained win of the parity campaign; GDN family 750.7ms -> ~120ms projected

screen_evidence.note: 1e-6/layer kernel deltas amplify through the 36-layer recurrence chain; boundary at 27 admissible

debugging_notes: initial fault: tail kernel indexed norm_weight[v_head*128+col] but the owner shares a 128-element norm across heads; fixed to norm_weight[col]
an earlier microbench reference mirrored the same wrong indexing, explaining a spurious 'owner vs numpy 17%' scare
